name: Locations workspace navigation and operational state transitions

planSteps.description: Navigate to /locations on the PolarOps frontend
Verify Locations workspace header 'Locations - Operational facilities, field depots, and logistics nodes' is visible
Verify status filter buttons (All, Available, Restricted, Inaccessible, Closed) and search input are present
Click on a location row or code chip to open the LocationDetailPanel drawer
Verify drawer displays location metadata, coordinates, data provenance tag, and allowed operational state transition buttons
Click a transition button (e.g. RESTRICTED) to prompt confirmation dialog
Verify confirmation dialog opens before mutation is submitted
